info.name: StyleMind Wardrobe — Share Outfits US-05.03
info.description: Importable local collection for the Share Outfits APIs of wardrobe-community-service, called through the API Gateway at /wardrobe-community. Needs two verified CUSTOMER test accounts (A shares with B) and one existing ACTIVE Commerce variant. Sharing triggers a real invitation email through Notification (see Mailpit). Requests create and delete test outfits; never save or export a populated collection or environment into the repository.
